description:
### Workflow for LongRead Quality Control and Filtering - NanoPlot (read quality control) before and after filtering - Filtlong (read trimming) - Kraken2 taxonomic read classification before and after filtering - Minimap2 read filtering based on given references

Other UNLOCK workflows on WorkflowHub: https://workflowhub.eu/projects/16/workflows?view=default

**All tool CWL files and other workflows can be found here:**
https://gitlab.com/m-unlock/cwl/workflows **How to setup and use an UNLOCK workflow:**
https://m-unlock.gitlab.io/docs/setup/setup.html
name: LongRead Quality Control and Filtering
tools: converts the file array to a single file object
preparation of fastp output files to a specific output folder
prepare bbmap references to a single fasta file and unique headers
quality assessment and report of reads before filter
removal of contaminated reads using minimap2 mapping
visualization of kraken2 classification with krona
